The external C sources of the Modelica Standard Library 4.1.0 (Modelica/Resources/C-Sources) are not patched.
They are taken from the OpenModelica fork of the library (https://github.com/OpenModelica/OpenModelica-ModelicaStandardLibrary),
pinned on a commit of the OM/maint/4.1.x branch (see modelicalib_commit in 3rdParty/CMakeLists.txt).

Since MSL 4.0.0, the table and columns arguments of the ModelicaStandardTables_*_init functions are already declared const
(const double* table, const int* columns), as required by the code generated for Dynawo models that is compiled in C++.

Warning: DYNModelicaOverridenFunctions.cpp copies the internal structures CombiTimeTable, CombiTable1D and CombiTable2D
and the Smoothness, Extrapolation, TimeEvents enumerations of ModelicaStandardTables.c (checked against MSL 4.1.0).
They have to be checked if the version of the Modelica Standard Library is changed.
